title: One article, translated and summarised
about: Each paragraph is translated on its own; the summary is made from the whole article, and a post is made from the summary and one translation.

steps.xml: <doc><title>Right to be forgotten</title><para>Alice asked for her data to be removed.</para><para>Her address appeared in the second paragraph.</para><para>The rest of the article is about the law.</para></doc>
<translation lang='fr'>Alice a demandé la suppression de ses données.</translation>
<translation lang='fr'>Son adresse figurait dans le deuxième paragraphe.</translation>
<translation lang='fr'>Le reste de l'article porte sur la loi.</translation>
<summary>A request to be forgotten, and the law behind it.</summary>
<post>Read the summary, and the French for the key paragraph.</post>

checks.name: shredding one paragraph kills its translation and everything made from the whole
shredding a translation kills only what was made from it
adding a paragraph kills what was made from the whole document
